description: Java class 'AndroidTargetData' providing Android SDK target data management, resource parsing, and layout library loading for Android development within IntelliJ IDEA.

classes.name: AndroidTargetData
classes.description: Main class managing Android SDK target data, resource parsing, and layout library loading.

classes.name: AndroidTargetData.MyStaticConstantsData
classes.description: Inner class holding static constants like activity, service, receiver actions, and categories.

classes.name: AndroidTargetData.PublicAttributeDefinitions
classes.description: Inner class extending FilteredAttributeDefinitions to filter public attributes.

classes.name: AndroidTargetData.MyPublicResourceCacheBuilder
classes.description: Inner class for parsing public resource cache XML files.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getAttrDefs
methods.description: Returns attribute definitions wrapped as public attribute definitions.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getAttrDefsImpl
methods.description: Internal method to load attribute definitions from XML files.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getPublicResourceCache
methods.description: Returns cached public resource map, parsing if necessary.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.isResourcePublic
methods.description: Checks if a resource of given type and name is public.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.parsePublicResCache
methods.description: Parses public.xml to build resource cache.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getLayoutLibrary
methods.description: Loads and returns the layout library for rendering.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.clearLayoutBitmapCache
methods.description: Clears cached layout bitmaps for a module.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.findXmlFiles
methods.description: Finds and loads XML files from given paths.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getStaticConstantsData
methods.description: Returns static constants data, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: AndroidTargetData.getFrameworkResources
methods.description: Loads framework resources for the target.
